title: Best Stock Profit
prompt: A stock practice app receives one price per day. Write a function that returns the maximum profit from buying once and selling later. Return 0 when no profitable trade exists.

explanation.beginner: Start by identifying what the function receives and what it must return. For Best Stock Profit, read the story as a simple input-to-output rule: A stock practice app receives one price per day. Write a function that returns the maximum profit from buying once and selling later. Return 0 when no profitable trade exists. Work through one small example by hand, then write the steps in JavaScript using plain variables before worrying about making the code shorter.
explanation.junior: Treat this as a small pure JavaScript function: avoid mutating inputs unless the prompt explicitly asks for it, return the requested shape exactly, and let the tests drive the edge cases.
